description: Prepare setup for a user-managed connector connection in the selected service deployment (ring) and environment. This is separate from signing in to Copilot Studio. Use the connector API name returned by the service, not a guessed URL. Agent Node (shared_agentnode) uses this same discovery and setup path; do not substitute a runtime placeholder for a real connection and Dataverse reference. Does not create, repair, sign in, or open a browser. For a setup plan, show the action, ring, account and environment and ask approval. If choices are returned, ask which connection to use and prepare again with that exact name, or set createNew:true to add a separate connection. New OAuth connections try single sign-on as the displayed account; set useSingleSignOn:false when the user wants another connector account. Supported user-connection creation depends on connector metadata.

connectionName.description: Exact platform connection name from discovery (connectionId in the current server catalog), not its display name or Dataverse connection reference.

createNew.description: Prepare a separate new connection instead of reusing or repairing an existing one. Leaves existing connections unchanged. Cannot be combined with connectionName.

useSingleSignOn.description: Default true: attempt server-side SSO for a newly created OAuth connection as the displayed bridge account. Set false if the user wants to choose another connector account through browser sign-in. Does not silently reauthenticate an existing shared connection.

name: copilot_studio_prepare_connection
title: Prepare connector connection setup
